name: run_ledger_funding_long_short
description: Funding sign check: a long with positive rate pays (negative cashflow), a short with the same positive rate receives. Funding uses qty*mult*mark at the funding instant.
derivation: initial wallet 1000. FILL AAA +2 @100 fee=0 slip=0: entry 100, mark 100, wallet 1000. FILL BBB -3 @50 fee=0 slip=0: entry 50, mark 50, wallet 1000; BBB signed notional=-3*1*50=-150. FUNDING AAA rate=0.0001 mark_price=100: signed notional=2*1*100=+200; cashflow=-200*0.0001=-0.02; wallet=999.98; funding_cum=-0.02. FUNDING BBB rate=0.0001 mark_price=50: signed notional=-3*1*50=-150; cashflow=-(-150)*0.0001=+0.015; wallet=999.98+0.015=999.995; funding_cum=-0.02+0.015=-0.005. Marks equal entries, so unrealized=0 for both; equity=999.995+0=999.995. Final: wallet 999.995, unrealized 0, equity 999.995, realized 0, fees 0, funding -0.005, positions AAA +2, BBB -3.
